brief.headline: Green, warm stone and Rose Earth lead 2027, and January planners start saving now: publish the pins they'll find in the new year.
brief.summary: Pinterest Predicts 2027 lands on 8 December and Pantone is due in early December, so today's job is to get evergreen, keyword-led pins indexed before the January planning peak. The colour story for 2027 is clear: Dulux chose Soulful Sage, UK bathroom designers' top pick is Graham & Brown's Rose Earth, and natural stone searches on Houzz UK are up 96%. Matt black brassware, fluted everything and blue bathrooms are losing momentum, which makes a strong 'skip this, choose that' carousel. Lead every pin with real photography or studio designs, link each one to the 3D studio or the exact product, and save it to a tightly named board.

trends.name: Green leads the 2027 colours (Dulux Soulful Sage)
trends.what_it_is: Dulux's Colour of the Year 2027 is Soulful Sage, a light silvery sage. Benjamin Moore (Webster Green), Sherwin-Williams (Celery) and Behr (Grounded, a mossy olive) also chose greens.
trends.why_now: Ideal Home's 2027 colour round-up (4 Nov 2026): 'green, in many shades'. Pantone 2027 is expected in early December and many forecasters predict a green.
trends.how_we_use_it: Sage walls with warm stone and brushed brass: a palette pin and a studio design in the same look.

trends.name: Rose Earth: the designers' bathroom colour for 2027
trends.what_it_is: Graham & Brown's 2027 colour, a dusty clay pink with brown undertones.
trends.why_now: Top pick of UK bathroom designers for 2027 (9 of 14 in the Sanctuary Bathrooms survey, Oct 2026). Earthy, warm palettes lead the designer forecasts.
trends.how_we_use_it: A Rose Earth, walnut and zellige mood board, paired with a matching studio design.

trends.name: Neo Deco: red marble and brass
trends.what_it_is: Art Deco revival with marble, chrome and brass.
trends.why_now: Pinterest Predicts 2026: 'red marble bathroom' +80% and 'brass aesthetic' +35%, the only bathroom-specific term in the report. Mandarin Stone's 2026 tile trends feature red and claret marbles.
trends.how_we_use_it: A dramatic statement pin: a cloakroom or powder room in red-veined stone with brass.

trends.name: Natural stone and texture
trends.what_it_is: Stone walls, limewash, Venetian plaster and natural stone basins.
trends.why_now: Houzz UK searches (Jan to Mar 2026): 'stone walls' +148%, 'limewash' +109%, 'natural stone' +96%. Natural stone picked by 71% of designers for 2027.
trends.how_we_use_it: Material close-ups: the Artize stone basin, limestone, walnut. Collage pins drive clicks.

trends.name: Warm metals up, matt black down
trends.what_it_is: Brushed bronze and aged brass are rising; matt black brassware, fluted designs and blue bathrooms are losing momentum.
trends.why_now: Sanctuary Bathrooms 2027 report (27 Oct 2026): brushed bronze picked by 71% of designers, unit sales up 60%; no manufacturer expects matt black to grow.
trends.how_we_use_it: A 'skip it, choose this' carousel and pins for 2027.

trends.name: Walk-in showers, wet rooms and accessible design
trends.what_it_is: Level-access showers, seats, wet rooms and accessible bathrooms that don't look clinical.
trends.why_now: Houzz UK (Jan to Mar 2026): 'accessible bathrooms' up 5x, 'showers with seats' +84%, 'walk-in showers' +37%, 'wet rooms' +19%.
trends.how_we_use_it: 'This vs that' pins and an accessible-luxury board.

trends.name: Plan in the quiet week: Pinterest's 'Q5'
trends.what_it_is: Between Christmas and New Year, Pinterest users plan the year ahead.
trends.why_now: Pinterest: 'home organisation ideas' searches rise 75% in that week; Pinterest advises publishing about two months before a seasonal peak. Pinterest Predicts 2027 arrives on 8 December.
trends.how_we_use_it: Publish planning checklists and cost guides now so they are indexed before January; refresh trend pins after 8 December.

trends.name: Carousels lead engagement, real photos win on Pinterest
trends.what_it_is: Carousels top Instagram engagement; Pinterest labels AI-modified images and lets home decor users see fewer of them.
trends.why_now: Buffer 2026: carousels 6.90% engagement vs 3.31% for Reels. Pinterest's 'AI modified' labels and filters are live.
trends.how_we_use_it: Lead with real project photography; label studio renders as 3D designs; use 2:3 pins at 1000 x 1500.

watch_outs: Pinterest Predicts 2027 is published on 8 December 2026 and Pantone 2027 is due in early December: refresh trend pins then, and do not claim what they will say before they are out.
Pinterest labels AI-modified images and lets home decor users hide them: lead with real photography and clearly label studio renders as 3D designs.
Quote cost figures with source and month on the image.
Link every pin to the studio or the exact product, never the home page; add UTMs to measure designs started.
Survey figures (Sanctuary, 14 designers) are a small sample: say 'designers surveyed', not 'most designers'.
